bias.zh: 看空 · 失守 $183，守住 5 日均线

read.en: Arm fell 2.6% on Nov 10 to $181.49, trading $175.77–186.51. It is above the 5-day ($180.2) and below the 10-day ($197.1), 30-day ($235.6), 100-day ($267.2) and 200-day ($231.5); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($216.17), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Arm 11月10日下跌 2.6%，收于 $181.49，盘中区间 $175.77–186.51。股价位于 5 日（$180.2）均线上方，10 日（$197.1）、30 日（$235.6）、100 日（$267.2）和 200 日（$231.5）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$216.17），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The close lost the $183.2 support (Oct 27, 2025 high), now resistance, after the $186.51 high faded; the 5-day ($180.2) held. Resistance is $183.2–186.5 (Nov 10 high), then $189.9–191.8 (Nov 4 low and close, Nov 9 high) and $196.1–197.1 (Nov 2 low, 10-day). Support is $174.8–177.6, then $169.6 and $163.1. A close above $186.5 would target $190–192; below $174.8, $169.6.
